# Extract Selection Metrics

```{r}
#| label: set selection metric

selection_metric <- "average_precision"
```

```{r}
#| label: get best result per imp and spec

extract_selection_metrics <- function(wfsets,
                                      selection_metric = "average_precision",
                                      selection_metric_max = TRUE) {
  # get combined table (just the ones returned by rank_results)
  selection_metrics_norank <- imap(wfset_ids, \(id, imp) {
    # load new wfset
    x <- load_wf_set(id)
    # extract metrics
    all_configs <- x %>%
      rank_results() %>%
      filter(.metric == selection_metric) %>%
      group_by(wflow_id)
    if (selection_metric_max) {
      best_configs <- all_configs %>%
        filter(mean == max(mean, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
        slice_max(mean, n = 1) %>%
        select(wflow_id, .config)
    } else {
      best_configs <- all_configs %>%
        filter(mean == min(mean, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
        select(wflow_id, .config)
    }
    out <- x %>%
      rank_results() %>%
      right_join(best_configs, by = join_by(wflow_id, .config)) %>%
      mutate(imp = imp) %>%
      relocate(imp)
    # remove from memory
    rm(x)
    gc()
    # end
    print(paste0(imp, " done!"))
    return(out)
  })

  selection_metrics_norank <- selection_metrics_norank %>%
    bind_rows() %>%
    select(-c(rank, n, preprocessor)) # rank not meaningful, n & preprocessor static (5 & recipe)


  if (selection_metric_max) {
    rank_table <- selection_metrics_norank %>%
      filter(.metric == selection_metric) %>%
      mutate(rank = min_rank(desc(mean))) %>%
      select(imp, wflow_id, .config, rank)
  } else {
    rank_table <- selection_metrics_norank %>%
      filter(.metric == selection_metric) %>%
      mutate(rank = min_rank(mean)) %>%
      select(imp, wflow_id, .config, rank)
  }

  selection_metrics <- selection_metrics_norank %>%
    left_join(rank_table,
      by = join_by(imp, wflow_id, .config),
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) %>%
    relocate(rank, imp, model, wflow_id) %>%
    mutate(is_selection_metric = if_else(.metric == selection_metric, TRUE, FALSE)) %>%
    arrange(rank, desc(is_selection_metric)) %>%
    select(-is_selection_metric) %>%
    rename_with(~ sub("^\\.", "", .x)) # remove leading . from .metric & .config

  return(selection_metrics)
}


selection_metrics <- extract_selection_metrics(wfset_ids, selection_metric = selection_metric)
```

```{r}
#| label: export selection metrics

selection_metrics %>%
  mutate(value = paste0(round(mean, 5), " (", round(std_err, 5), ")")) %>%
  select(-c(mean, std_err)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = value) %>%
  select(-c("wflow_id", "config")) %>%
  mutate(
    model = case_when(
      model == "boost_tree" ~ "Gradient Boosting",
      model == "rand_forest" ~ "Random Forest",
      model == "logistic_reg" ~ "Elastic Net",
      TRUE ~ NA
    ),
    imp = case_when(
      imp == "avg" ~ "median/mode",
      imp == "model" ~ "model-based",
      imp == "bag" ~ "bagged trees",
      TRUE ~ NA
    )
  ) %>%
  rename(
    "#" = rank,
    Imp = imp,
    Model = model,
    "Avg. Prec." = average_precision,
    "Brier Score" = brier_class,
    "Log Loss" = mn_log_loss,
    "PR AUC" = pr_auc,
    "ROC AUC" = roc_auc
  ) %>%
  export_return(
    "06_metrics_tune",
    caption = "Threshold-independent Metrics of all tuned models. Standard Errors in Brackets. Best Performances per Metric are highlighted in bold.",
    label = "metrics_tune",
    tabular.environment = "tabularx",
    align = c("r", "L", "L", "R"),
    break.chars = c("_", "/")
  )

# find position of highest value per metric so i know what to bold
# determine best value for each metric
bold <- selection_metrics %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  mutate(
    bold = case_when(
      metric %in% c("brier_class", "mn_log_loss") ~
        mean == min(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      TRUE ~
        mean == max(mean, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(rank, metric, bold) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = metric,
    values_from = bold,
    values_fill = FALSE
  ) %>%
  arrange(rank) %>%
  select(
    average_precision,
    brier_class,
    mn_log_loss,
    pr_auc,
    roc_auc
  )

# add columns that should never be bold
bold <- bind_cols(
  matrix(FALSE, nrow = nrow(bold), ncol = 3),
  bold
) %>%
  as.matrix()

# add bold formatting to exported LaTeX
tex <- readLines(file.path(PATH_TABLE, "06_metrics_tune.tex"))

rows <- grep("^\\s+[0-9]+\\s+&", tex)

for (i in seq_along(rows)) {
  row <- tex[rows[i]]

  # separate table row from trailing LaTeX row terminator
  parts <- strsplit(row, "\\\\\\\\", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  cells <- strsplit(parts[1], " & ", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]

  for (j in seq_len(ncol(bold))) {
    if (bold[i, j]) {
      cells[j] <- paste0("\\textbf{", cells[j], "}")
    }
  }

  tex[rows[i]] <- paste0(paste(cells, collapse = " & "), " \\\\")
}

writeLines(tex, file.path(PATH_TABLE, "06_metrics_tune.tex"))
```

```{r}
#| label: difference between best and worst combination

# absolute increase
selection_metrics %>%
  filter(metric == "average_precision") %>%
  arrange(rank) %>%
  filter(rank %in% c(1, 9)) %>%
  pull(mean) %>%
  {
    .[1] - .[2]
  }

# relative increase
selection_metrics %>%
  filter(metric == "average_precision") %>%
  arrange(rank) %>%
  filter(rank %in% c(1, 9)) %>%
  pull(mean) %>%
  {
    (.[1] - .[2]) / .[2]
  }
```

# Plot Model Performance

```{r}
#| label: tuned model comparison
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6

selection_metrics %>%
  filter(metric == selection_metric) %>%
  mutate(
    model = case_when(
      model == "boost_tree" ~ "Gradient Boosting",
      model == "rand_forest" ~ "Random Forest",
      model == "logistic_reg" ~ "Elastic Net",
      TRUE ~ NA
    ),
    imp = case_when(
      imp == "avg" ~ "median/mode",
      imp == "model" ~ "model-based",
      imp == "bag" ~ "bagged trees",
      TRUE ~ NA
    ),
  ) %>%
  arrange(rank) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mean, y = fct_rev(fct_inorder(paste(model, "\n", imp, sep = ""))), color = model, shape = imp)) +
  geom_point(size = 5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = mean - 1.96 * std_err, xmax = mean + 1.96 * std_err), width = 0.1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  guides(shape = "none") +
  guides(color = "none") +
  color_qualitative() +
  labs(
    x = "mean",
    y = "",
    color = "Model Specification",
    shape = "Imputation Technique",
    title = "Average Precision per model x imputation technique combination",
    subtitle = "Truncated x-axis for interpretability",
    caption = ""
  ) -
  partial(export_return,
    filename = "06_tuning-performance",
    width = 10,
    height = 6
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: tuned model comparison w full scale
```

# Determine & Train best Model

```{r}
#| label: get best wf

selected_config <- list(
  imp = selection_metrics %>% filter(rank == 1, metric == selection_metric) %>% pull(imp),
  wf = selection_metrics %>% filter(rank == 1, metric == selection_metric) %>% pull(wflow_id),
  config = selection_metrics %>% filter(rank == 1, metric == selection_metric) %>% pull(config),
  threshold = NA
)

# load wfset of chosen imputation technique
selected_wfset <- load_wf_set(selected_config[["imp"]])

selected_params <- selected_wfset %>%
  extract_workflow_set_result(selected_config[["wf"]]) %>%
  select_best(metric = selection_metric)

selected_wf <- selected_wfset %>%
  extract_workflow(selected_config[["wf"]]) %>%
  finalize_workflow(selected_params)
```

# Export

```{r}
#| label: export

save_selected_config(selected_config, threshold = FALSE)
save_selected_wf(selected_wf)
```
